title: hedyotis costata
intro: Hedyotis costata, commonly known as the "thunder of heaven" plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, due to its reported health benefits of reducing fever and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis costata include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. The exact composition of these bioactive constituents is still being researched, but studies suggest that they contribute to the plant's medicinal properties.
